config.cold: First query on fresh reader instances; no decoding verification pass before it.
config.warm: Immediate repeat of the same IDs on those instances, before correctness checks.

ordering: For round r, case offset o uses (o + r) modulo schedule length. Samples run sequentially.

timerBoundaries.localQueries: Reader performance.now around runReadQuery, including requested .get/getView/toObject calls, predicates and result capture; excluding response transport and correctness checks. Report max of two parallel local durations; all individual durations retained.
timerBoundaries.roundTrips: Owner performance.now through both complete worker replies, including request scheduling and full output transport.
timerBoundaries.constructionToFirstAnswer: Each sample: constructionMs + publicationMs + firstRoundTripMs. Excludes worker/module startup, fixture generation, validation, inter-phase RPC and DOM.
timerBoundaries.startup: Separately recorded setup elapsed time. Not included in construction-through-first-answer.
timerBoundaries.verification: Independent expected output is checked after both first and repeat queries. All rows/fields/counts/misses/order and current/retained revisions are checked.

config.cold: First query on fresh reader instances; no decoding verification pass before it.
config.warm: Same IDs repeated after the independent owner reference check; no extra reader decoding or validation pass.

legacy.method: Unchanged catalog fixture and query workload. Fresh owner and two readers. Worker/module startup excluded. Full-field fingerprint generation occurs INSIDE the query timer; the independent owner reference check occurs AFTER the timer. Query elapsed time includes request/reply messaging and result transport. Four baseline cases measure all nine phases; full-copy variants only measure edited publication and combined edit/publication. Initial replicas clone the full catalog; incremental edits clone 100 pairs, full edits clone the current catalog, SharedMap sends shared descriptors. Full-copy cases still verify current and retained revisions. No DOM or memory measurement.
